en.name: PM Vishwakarma (support for traditional artisans)
en.summary: Recognition, training, a toolkit grant and cheap loans for people who work with their hands and tools in one of 18 traditional trades, such as carpenters, blacksmiths, potters, cobblers, masons, barbers, tailors, washermen and goldsmiths.
en.benefit: A PM Vishwakarma certificate and ID card; 5 days of basic training and 15 days or more of advanced training, with ₹500 a day as a stipend; a ₹15,000 toolkit incentive; collateral-free loans of up to ₹1 lakh (first part, 18 months) and then up to ₹2 lakh (second part, 30 months) at 5% interest; ₹1 per digital transaction for up to 100 transactions a month; and marketing support.
en.how_to_apply: Register at a Common Service Centre (CSC). Registration uses Aadhaar with biometrics. The gram panchayat head or urban local body checks your application, then the district committee. Only one member of a family (husband, wife and unmarried children) can register. Mudra or PM SVANidhi borrowers who have fully repaid can apply.

hi.name: पीएम विश्वकर्मा (पारंपरिक कारीगरों के लिए सहायता)
hi.summary: 18 पारंपरिक कामों में हाथ और औज़ारों से काम करने वालों, जैसे बढ़ई, लोहार, कुम्हार, मोची, राजमिस्त्री, नाई, दर्ज़ी, धोबी और सुनार, के लिए पहचान, प्रशिक्षण, औज़ार सहायता और सस्ता ऋण।
hi.benefit: पीएम विश्वकर्मा प्रमाण पत्र और पहचान पत्र; 5 दिन का बुनियादी और 15 दिन या ज़्यादा का उन्नत प्रशिक्षण, ₹500 रोज़ भत्ते के साथ; ₹15,000 की औज़ार सहायता; बिना गिरवी के ₹1 लाख तक (पहली किस्त, 18 महीने) और फिर ₹2 लाख तक (दूसरी किस्त, 30 महीने) का ऋण, 5% ब्याज पर; हर डिजिटल लेनदेन पर ₹1, महीने में 100 लेनदेन तक; और बाज़ार से जोड़ने में मदद।
hi.how_to_apply: कॉमन सर्विस सेंटर (CSC) पर पंजीकरण करें। पंजीकरण आधार और बायोमेट्रिक से होता है। ग्राम पंचायत प्रमुख या नगर निकाय आवेदन जाँचता है, फिर ज़िला समिति। परिवार (पति, पत्नी और अविवाहित बच्चे) से केवल एक सदस्य पंजीकरण कर सकता है। जिन्होंने मुद्रा या पीएम स्वनिधि ऋण पूरा चुका दिया है, वे आवेदन कर सकते हैं।

sources.title: PM Vishwakarma Scheme: Honouring Heritage, Powering Progress

text.en: Works on their own, with hands and tools, in one of the 18 traditional trades
text.hi: 18 पारंपरिक कामों में से किसी एक में अपने बल पर, हाथ और औज़ारों से काम करते हैं

rules.quote: An artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools and engaged in one of the family-based traditional trades specified in Para 2.3, in the unorganized or informal sector, on self-employment basis
The minimum age of the beneficiary should be 18 years on the date of registration.

text.en: No government self-employment loan in the last 5 years (fully repaid Mudra or PM SVANidhi loans are fine)
text.hi: पिछले 5 साल में कोई सरकारी स्वरोज़गार ऋण नहीं (पूरा चुकाया मुद्रा या पीएम स्वनिधि ऋण चलेगा)

rules.quote: should not have availed loans under similar credit-based schemes of Central Government or State Government for self-employment/ business development, e.g. PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, MUDRA, in the past 5 years. However, the beneficiaries of MUDRA and SVANidhi who have fully repaid their loan, will be eligible under PM Vishwakarma.

text.en: No one in the family works in government service
text.hi: परिवार में कोई सरकारी नौकरी में नहीं है

rules.quote: A person in government service and his/her family members shall not be eligible under the Scheme.

facts.quote: Each beneficiary will be eligible to receive a training stipend of Rs. 500 per day while undergoing the Basic and Advanced Training programmes.
A toolkit incentive of upto Rs. 15,000 will be provided to the beneficiary after Skill Assessment at the start of Basic Training.
Upto Rs 1 lakh (First Tranche for 18 months repayment) Upto Rs 2 lakh (Second Tranche for 30 months repayment)
Concessional rate of interest chargeable to beneficiaries for loan will be fixed at 5%.
An amount of Re. 1 per eligible digital transaction (upto maximum 100 eligible transactions monthly) will be credited to the beneficiary’s bank account
(a) Skill Identification followed by 5 days Basic Training (b) 15 days or more Advanced Training
Artisan and craftspersons are provided with the PM Vishwakarma certificate and ID Cards
